purpose: Prospectively test whether reduced floral investment under sustained visitor-replenishment limitation does not require evolving reproductive-assurance capacity, and whether allowing assurance evolution attenuates the between-environment investment contrast, across all four pre-existing reproductive settings.

relation_to_prior_evidence.boundary: The 2026-10-05 intervention exposed this attenuation pattern in assurance_cost and prior_selfing only. This campaign uses new visitor histories and demographic repeats and expands to delayed_control and pollen_discount without reusing discovery outcomes.

main_campaign.inference_unit: visitor history; eight demographic repeats are nested
main_campaign.founders: Same original 48 matching/investment founders, with both assurance alleles forced to 0.5 in fixed and evolving modes.

estimands.attenuation: (evolving far-minus-near terminal investment contrast) - (fixed far-minus-near terminal investment contrast), computed on the same surviving four-cell replicate set
secondary: fixed-mode far investment change from founders

structural_control.rule: Within every matched setting-history-repeat-arm cell, fixed and evolving full traces must be exactly identical. This is an implementation control, not biological replication.

admissibility.interaction_survival: The attenuation estimand uses only demographic repeats occupied at period 1000 in fixed-near, fixed-far, evolving-near and evolving-far.

frozen_success_rule.per_setting: Admissible AND fixed far-minus-near investment mean < 0 with its 95% visitor-history bootstrap upper bound < 0 AND attenuation mean > 0 with its 95% visitor-history bootstrap lower bound > 0.
frozen_success_rule.all_four: All four settings pass the per-setting rule.
frozen_success_rule.partial: One to three settings pass; retain JE as the primary target and report attenuation as setting-dependent secondary evidence.
frozen_success_rule.none: No setting passes; retain the existing JE claim without the general attenuation statement.
frozen_success_rule.journal_decision: all_four -> Ecology Letters first / Journal of Ecology backup; partial or none -> Journal of Ecology first.

reporting_rules.no_partial_readout: No biological summary until all 8448 declared trajectories and receipts are present and verified.
reporting_rules.no_retuning: No seed extension, threshold change, outcome substitution, model-parameter adjustment or setting exclusion after execution begins.
reporting_rules.all_settings: Report all four settings regardless of direction, including failed or inadmissible cells.
reporting_rules.claim_boundary: A positive attenuation interaction means assurance evolution narrows the near-far investment difference in this model. It is not a mediation fraction, does not imply selfing itself is absent, and does not establish an empirical flower-size causal effect.
reporting_rules.selection_gradient_boundary: Mechanistic interpretation must use the corrected fixed-resident rare-mutant invasion gradient, not the retired whole-population derivative.
